name: Pedn Olva
accommodation: En-suite rooms with harbour and ocean views
beachAccess: Set on rocks above St Ives Bay at Porthminster; the website highlights Porthmeor for surfing
confirmedFeatures: Bar, restaurant, terraces, pub garden, WiFi
overview: A hotel built on granite rocks above St Ives Bay, with en-suite rooms looking out over the harbour and the ocean. It has a bar and restaurant and terraces right above the sea. The town's beaches are close by, and the hotel's own website points surfers to Porthmeor.
surfTripFit: It is a central base, a walk away from Porthmeor and the town's other beaches.
